name: Riday Raheja
intro: Hi I’m Riday, a creative 3D artist with professional experience spanning product visualization, motion graphics, interior and event visualization. Scroll down to look at some of my work!
about: I make 3D renders, motion graphics and event visuals, mostly in Blender and Adobe Creative Suite. I'm finishing a BSc in Marketing & Management at Loughborough University.
operations_intro: Alongside the design work, I've run the ground side of live sports events: logistics, vendors, venues and the people who make a match day happen.
